text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello held a large-scale briefing on 
the Grand Live for the Academy's 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A Grand Live where everyone can sing—no 
matter whose fan they are, it is also a 
place where fans can convey their feelings 
to the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon provided backup support as 
well. Suggesting that Umamusume, too, have 
things they want to express to their fans 
beyond mere gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The passion generated when the desires and 
egos of both Umamusume and fans clash— 
will surely become the power to expand 
one's potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The speech given by the two moved the 
Umamusume's hearts. Before long, voices 
eager to participate began echoing from 
the venue.
